fact: The ministry convened stakeholders to review ongoing efforts to put in place a Government Enterprise Architecture, described as a common reference framework for coherence among public policies, processes, data, applications and the State's digital infrastructure, with the system inventory still to be drawn up; the document is dated 2026-08-03 and gives no event date.

The ministry announced that on 5 May 2026 it would present the draft decree governing the interoperability platform and introduce the national interoperability framework, data-exchange architectures, technical standards and security requirements; both were still at presentation stage, not adopted.

The ministry states that Phase 1 (MVP 1.0), whose deliverables a steering committee with JICA and Accenture validated on 2026-03-26, produced a national interoperability framework and a draft decree (projet de décret); no adoption of the framework or decree is stated.

A workshop on 2026-07-29 presented interim results of the Government Enterprise Architecture project, a common reference framework for policies, processes, data, applications and digital infrastructure; the diagnostic phase was reviewed, the target architecture was proposed and the state information-system inventory was launched.
